correctness.rationale: For Q4, level-j Walsh eigenspaces have dimensions 1,4,6,4,1, so at least six independent coordinate actuators are necessary. For any six sampled vertices, middle even Walsh degree2 forces six distinct antipodal pairs. An 8x8 even-Walsh matrix and Jacobi complementary-minor identity make the 6x6 middle determinant nonzero precisely when the two unsampled antipodal classes have opposite parity. Degree1 and degree3 Walsh restrictions remain injective since a nonzero linear combination vanishes on at most four antipodal pairs; outer levels are nowhere zero. Exactly 4*4*2^6=1024 valid 6-sets; exhaustive action of 384 automorphisms partitions into eight orbits sized 32,32,96,96,192,192,192,192. Independent modular ranks over 257 for all 8008 sets agree with the criterion, and Hadamard bound |det|<=216 makes mod257 checks rationally conclusive.
